answer: A sybil swarm is a fable only its author believes: one operator splitting into a crowd of puppets. We break it by demanding each identity's work be attested by a quorum of peers from outside its own referral tree. A bribed whisper between kin counts for nothing; confirmation must ripple in from strangers who share no invite edge. No non-kin ripple, no reward — so spinning up ten clones buys ten mouths but zero trust.
